title: Why CI went red — and the fix
lines: Commit d18edb7 · run 34690434940 · End-to-end tests failed after 1 retry:
getByRole('link', { name: 'Dune: Part Two' }) resolved to 2 elements — the poster link
and the title link both match, so Playwright's strict mode aborts the click.
The gate job "CI green" reported failure, so the branch could not be merged.
Fix commit 150f563: match the link and button names exactly (exact: true). CI is green again.
